s.note: Newt and Jacob arriving in Paris
s.how: Cut 2 puff pastry sheets into long triangles. Lay a stick of dark chocolate at the wide end and roll up towards the point. Curve into crescents, brush with beaten egg and bake at 200C for 15 minutes until puffed and golden.

Mix 500g flour, 7g yeast, 2 eggs, 50g butter and warm milk into a soft dough and prove an hour. Roll into balls, prove again and fry at 175C until golden. Pipe plum jam into each and dust with icing sugar. A proper bakery treat.

m.note: Paris in 1927, the night of the rally
m.how: Brown 1.2kg chicken pieces and 150g bacon lardons. Add 12 small onions and 250g mushrooms, then 500ml red wine, 250ml stock and thyme. Simmer covered 45 minutes and serve with 800g potatoes mashed with butter.

w.note: Queenie and her magic in the kitchen
w.how: Toss 4 sliced green apples with 80g sultanas, a teaspoon of cinnamon and a handful of breadcrumbs. Layer buttered filo sheets, spread the filling along one edge and roll up. Brush with butter and bake at 190C for 35 minutes. Dust with icing sugar.

d.how: Brew a strong pot of coffee. Heat 1L milk until steaming and froth it with a whisk. Pour coffee and milk into big wide cups at the same time, half and half. Drink it at a Paris cafe table watching the street go by.
